frictions.description: Page reloads (due to eval-based localStorage updates) reset navigation state to the Validation view, requiring re-navigation to Settings > Proxy tab each time.
frictions.resolution: Re-navigated to Settings > Proxy after each reload via snapshot + click.

frictions.description: Tauri IPC errors appear in console ('Cannot read properties of undefined (reading transformCallback)') because the app runs in a browser context without the Tauri runtime.
frictions.resolution: Identified as expected behavior per user-testing.md documentation. Not related to the assertions being tested.

summary: Tested 3 assertions: 3 passed. Bad proxy detection correctly identifies proxies with >=3 consecutive failures, shows red 'Bad' badge visually, and resets the indicator when consecutive failure counter returns to 0.
